title: Work across services needs recovery
summary: A multi-step business action can partly succeed. A recovery action, often called compensation, tries to undo an earlier step.
introduction: A multi-step business action can partly succeed. A recovery action, often called compensation, tries to undo an earlier step. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain work across services needs recovery
Use the example to answer a practice question

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a recovery step for reserving then cancelling a lunch order.

blocks.text: Do not assume several services share one automatic database transaction.
